reviewer: QSB Tower V1.3 compatibility review process
review_note: No kernel classes were instantiated. No kernel code was executed. All analysis is static (AST scan + source text inspection).

kernel_identity.name: QSB Kernel
kernel_identity.cognitive_upgrade: 4.7 (belief engine, reflection engine, semantic memory — per COGNITIVE_47_README.md)
kernel_identity.principle: Models are workers. QSB is the kernel.

hash_verification.detail: All 13 hashed files match the import manifest SHA-256 values. Dormant import is intact.

kernel/kernel_core.py.side_effects_on_instantiation: YES — triggers side effects in all sub-cores (sqlite connects, state writes)
kernel/kernel_core.py.notes: Assembler. Pure composition. Risk comes entirely from what sub-cores do on __init__.

kernel/axiom_core.py.notes: Fully pure Python. Contains 10 axioms as class constants. Stateless. No side effects whatsoever. Directly portable.

kernel/identity_core.py.filesystem_writes: conditional — writes identity.json if file is absent on __init__
kernel/identity_core.py.side_effects_on_instantiation: conditional write to old skyscraper path
kernel/identity_core.py.rebase_effort: trivial — change one ROOT constant or inject path
kernel/identity_core.py.notes: Only risk is conditional write if identity.json absent at old path. Read-only use of identity.json is safe via dormant adapter.

kernel/continuity_core.py.filesystem_writes: YES — STATE_FILE.write_text() on every boot_check() call (line 46)
kernel/continuity_core.py.rebase_effort: medium — path rebase + continuity check field remapping
kernel/continuity_core.py.notes: boot_check() is called from QSBKernelCore.__init__. This means kernel instantiation WILL write to the old state file path. High risk if not rebased first.

kernel/belief_core.py.filesystem_writes: YES — sqlite3.connect(DB) on __init__, writes beliefs on seed()
kernel/belief_core.py.rebase_effort: low — change ROOT constant, SQLite schema is clean and self-contained
kernel/belief_core.py.notes: Belief engine is architecturally clean. SQLite schema has no external dependencies. Path rebase is the only blocker. 10 seed beliefs are tower-compatible.

kernel/symbolic_core.py.ollama_reference: METADATA ONLY — 'ollama' appears only in concept terms list for symbolic pattern matching (line 72), not as a network call
kernel/symbolic_core.py.rebase_effort: low — change ROOT constant, SQLite schema is clean
kernel/symbolic_core.py.notes: 14 symbolic concepts are architecturally aligned with tower. 'model', 'lift', 'department', 'skyscraper', 'kernel', etc. all map correctly to tower vocabulary.

kernel/reflection_core.py.dependency_injection: Takes memory, departments, missions, lifts, graph, beliefs, semantic as constructor args
kernel/reflection_core.py.notes: Cleanest kernel file. Pure reflection logic over injected dependencies. No hard-coded paths. Fully portable if dependencies are replaced with tower equivalents.

source_support/penthouse.py.network_calls: YES — via QSBRouter which calls Ollama HTTP API
source_support/penthouse.py.classification: MUST NOT BE EXECUTED — reference artifact only
source_support/penthouse.py.notes: This is the old skyscraper executive controller. Cannot run in tower context. None of its module imports exist in the new tower. Serves only as architectural reference.

source_support/add_cognitive_kernel_47.p.model_calls: YES — SemanticMemoryCore calls Ollama embedding model
source_support/add_cognitive_kernel_47.p.classification: MUST NOT BE EXECUTED — semantic memory upgrade script with live Ollama dependency
source_support/add_cognitive_kernel_47.p.notes: Contains SemanticMemoryCore which makes HTTP calls to Ollama for embeddings. Must be rewritten to use tower's provider layer when that is active.

source_support/promote_symbolic_to_kerne.notes: Migration script that moved symbolic logic from floor to kernel level. No network calls. Reference only.

old_path_assumptions.required_change: Replace hardcoded ROOT with configurable path pointing to new tower penthouse location
old_path_assumptions.suggested_approach: Inject ROOT as a constructor parameter OR use a shared config constant in a new tower kernel config module
old_path_assumptions.rebase_complexity: LOW — same pattern in each file, mechanical change

old_penthouse_assumptions.detail: penthouse.py assumes 8 old skyscraper modules exist. None exist in new tower.

old_module_to_new_tower_mapping.knowledge.graph_core.KnowledgeGraph: NO EQUIVALENT — not yet in tower

kernel_sub_cores.verdict: SAFE — no model calls in any of the 6 kernel sub-core files
kernel_sub_cores.detail: axiom_core, identity_core, continuity_core, belief_core, symbolic_core, reflection_core contain zero HTTP calls, zero Ollama calls, zero API calls

symbolic_core_ollama_ref.detail: The string 'ollama' in symbolic_core.py line 72 is a term in the 'model' concept definition for symbolic pattern matching (recognising the word 'ollama' in user input). It is not a network call.

penthouse_py.verdict: HIGH RISK — must not be run
penthouse_py.detail: QSBRouter calls Ollama. router.ask() sends prompts to local Ollama HTTP API.

add_cognitive_kernel_47_py.verdict: HIGH RISK — must not be run

filesystem_write_risks.verdict: PRESENT — will write to old paths if instantiated without path rebase
writes_on_kernel_instantiation: identity_core.py: writes /vaults/nvme0/qsb_skyscraper/kernel/identity.json if file absent on __init__
filesystem_write_risks.mitigation_required: Path rebase before activation. Dormant adapter currently reads identity.json and continuity_state.json as static files only — no writes triggered.

memory_state_write_risks.verdict: PRESENT — kernel sub-cores manage their own persistent state
state_files: continuity_state.json — boot history, hash drift log
qsb_beliefs.sqlite — belief engine with confidence scores
memory_state_write_risks.tower_impact: State files currently write to old skyscraper paths. After path rebase, they would write to tower penthouse paths. This is desired behaviour but must be gate-controlled.
memory_state_write_risks.mitigation: Path rebase + explicit operator approval before first kernel instantiation

provider_network_risks.kernel_sub_cores: NONE — zero network calls in all 6 kernel sub-core files
provider_network_risks.penthouse_py: HIGH — calls Ollama via QSBRouter (must not be run)
provider_network_risks.add_cognitive_47: HIGH — calls Ollama /api/embeddings via requests.post (must not be run)
provider_network_risks.tower_provider_policy: provider_execution_enabled=false, model_inference_enabled=false — correctly blocks any provider calls

kernel_sub_core_imports.verdict: LOW — all imports are stdlib (pathlib, datetime, json, hashlib, sqlite3)
kernel_sub_core_imports.relative_imports: use 'from kernel.X import Y' pattern — requires sys.path to include parent of kernel/ directory

import_risks.sys_path_requirement: kernel/ directory must be reachable via sys.path for inter-kernel imports to work. The new tower's src/ layout means kernel/ would need to be placed correctly or imports rewritten.
import_risks.proposed_placement: Place rebased kernel under src/tower/kernel_package/ and adjust imports to 'from tower.kernel_package.X import Y'

compatibility_score.scale: 0-100 (100 = fully compatible, drop-in; 0 = incompatible, requires complete rewrite)

kernel_logic_portability.notes: Axiom, belief, symbolic, identity, continuity, reflection — all pure Python with no external dependencies beyond stdlib. Logic is sound and architecturally aligned.

path_dependency_severity.notes: 4 of 6 sub-cores hardcode ROOT to old vault. Blocking but mechanical to fix.

module_import_compatibility.notes: Kernel sub-core imports are clean (stdlib only). penthouse.py imports 8 missing modules but penthouse.py is not the kernel.

architectural_alignment.notes: Axioms, belief engine, symbolic logic, continuity — all align with tower's 53-floor penthouse architecture. Tower vocabulary (floors, lifts, departments) is embedded in symbolic concepts.

provider_model_cleanliness.notes: Kernel sub-cores make zero model calls. Only penthouse.py and add_cognitive_47.py have model call risk, and both are excluded from the activation path.

side_effect_safety.notes: 4 sub-cores write to disk on instantiation. continuity_core writes on every boot_check(). Must be path-rebased before safe instantiation.

compatibility_score.overall_verdict: CONDITIONALLY_COMPATIBLE — the kernel logic is sound and aligned with the new tower. All blockers are mechanical (path rebasing, module import rewiring) rather than architectural. Activation is NOT allowed until blockers are resolved.

required_adapter_changes_before_activati.detail: Create a KernelActivationGate class that wraps QSBKernelCore instantiation and verifies kernel_installed=true, operator_approval=true, path_rebase_complete=true before allowing construction

required_adapter_changes_before_activati.title: Reflection core dependency injection adapter
required_adapter_changes_before_activati.detail: ReflectionCore requires memory, departments, missions, lifts, graph, beliefs, semantic as injected dependencies. Create tower-compatible adapter objects for each missing dependency (stub or real implementations)
required_adapter_changes_before_activati.effort: MEDIUM-HIGH — requires mapping to tower floor modules

required_adapter_changes_before_activati.title: Semantic memory rewrite (defer until provider layer active)
required_adapter_changes_before_activati.detail: SemanticMemoryCore in add_cognitive_kernel_47.py uses Ollama HTTP embeddings. Rewrite to use tower's local_model_operations layer when providers are active.
required_adapter_changes_before_activati.effort: MEDIUM — defer until tower provider execution is enabled

required_adapter_changes_before_activati.title: Lift system API translation
required_adapter_changes_before_activati.detail: Old LiftSystem.emit(bus, source, target, event, payload) must map to new LiftNetwork.send(lift_id, source, target, payload). Different signature.

required_safety_gates_before_activation.description: The kernel_installation_socket must be explicitly updated to kernel_installed=true by operator action. This flag transition is the primary activation gate.
All 4 path-hardcoded files must be rebased and tested independently before kernel is instantiated.
Explicit operator decision to activate must be recorded in the penthouse socket manifest.
Tower security spine must sign off on the activation.
penthouse_readiness.py acceptance must pass with zero critical failures after path rebase.
A new test suite must exercise the rebased kernel sub-cores independently before full integration.
provider_execution_enabled and model_inference_enabled must remain false during kernel activation. SemanticMemory stays disabled.

activation_allowed_reason: Activation requires completing ADAPTER_01, ADAPTER_02, ADAPTER_03, ADAPTER_04, passing GATE_01 through GATE_06. None of these are complete.

next_recommended_phase.description: Create rebased versions of the 4 path-hardcoded kernel files under a new location (e.g. penthouse/kernel_installation_socket/rebased_kernel/). Test each file independently in isolation without instantiating QSBKernelCore.
next_recommended_phase.timeline_note: Do not skip phases. Each phase must pass before the next begins.
